legacyHtml.biography:
Terry Bollea, known as Hulk Hogan and Hollywood Hogan, was an American wrestler whose red-and-yellow persona became a symbol of the 1980s wrestling boom.

Career in brief

After the territories, Japan and the AWA, he led WWF’s national expansion, became WCW’s top attraction and reinvented himself with the nWo. Later WWE returns and TNA appearances extended his career; his last recorded match was in 2012.

Match coverage: 281 indexed matches and 334 promo / appearance entries. The spreadsheet review added 207 matches and reconciled 71 matches already indexed. This remains a partial archive. Promotion brackets show documented runs and appearances, not complete match coverage.
